Draft Open Access Policy Implementation

The University Library Committee at the University of Wisconsin–Madison has formed a working group to develop an Open Access Policy for UW–Madison, through which university researchers would give UW–Madison the right to freely distribute pre-prints of all published journal articles.

The following is a list of needs related implementing such a policy.

  • upgrade software for Minds@UW

  • website for OA policy
    • frequently asked questions
    • web form for submission
    • web form for waiver

  • outreach to faculty to request preprints

  • staff time to answer questions and assist with preprints
